status: Declared BEFORE any result on these targets exists. Do not edit after the first stage-B run; changes create oc_v2 with its own correction.
question: What information known at the close of T predicts the return a buyer at the NEXT OPEN earns over 1, 2, 3 and 5 sessions?
entry: OPEN of T+1 (next bar of the symbol)
exit: CLOSE of T+h; plain return, no brackets, no stops
universe: panel_build v32: equities only (research_common ETF rule etf-v1 + <root>/universe_exclude.txt); point-in-time liquidity floor Rs 1 crore 60-session median turnover
eligibility: label_buyable_o1 == 1 for training AND scoring. Rows with 0 stay in the panel and are reported by year, symbol and market day; never silently dropped.
walk_forward: the 5 folds of feasibility_test.splits; embargo >= the target's horizon

stage_B_feature_screen.stability_gate: IC sign equal to the pooled mean's sign in at least 4 of 5 walk-forward folds
stage_B_feature_screen.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values across every feature x target cell; a feature passes only with q <= 0.10 AND the stability gate
stage_B_feature_screen.note: the highest IC alone never selects a feature

stage_D_gate.metric: walk-forward top-3 net return per trade at 35 bp, eligible rows only, ranked by the raw model score
stage_D_gate.interval: 98.75% block-bootstrap interval over trading days (95% with a Bonferroni correction for the 4 targets); the lower bound must be above zero
stage_D_gate.recency: the mean over 2024-01-01 onwards must also be above zero
stage_D_gate.also_reported: excess over buying every eligible stock with the same entry and horizon
stage_D_gate.on_pass: the engine becomes a forward paper-test arm; no real money until the production rule's month-6 check

rules: Adding any horizon, target, model family, universe or exit rule after this date creates a NEW family with its own correction; it never reuses the 98.75% threshold.
The ATR bracket labels (close and next-open) stay in the panel as archived comparison targets, not candidates.
The lockbox is spent; the forward paper ledger is the only untouched evidence.
Feature expansion (self-relative distances, interactions) is stage C: screened under the stage-B rules above, never added to the panel before stage B has run on the existing features.
